Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Low-level fusion: synchronised Raman and NIR spectra merged into one augmented matrix, as in the published feed-frame example. Both probes must sample the same slurry volume at one port, or a combined multispectral probe should be considered; data must be normalised to a common time step and block-scaled so neither method dominates. Each instrument keeps its own calibration, and the fused model must beat the best single-method model on held-out batches or the extra instrument is dropped.)
Achievable fiber link length for this specific installation (long cables are stated only for low-OH silica fibers; mid-IR fiber examples in the sources are short laboratory lengths).
